basis: Manually classified completed full-stack reconstructions from retained local reflogs and commit objects, not a count of non-fast-forward pushes. Initial historical seeds are incomplete lifetime evidence.
rebase_count_basis: No qualifying upstream-base move/port found in the retained local HEAD/branch logs and inspected provenance. Initial clone/import, fetches, same-base reconstructions and branch renames are excluded. Zero is an observed-evidence seed, not a complete lifetime claim.

policies.upstream_rebases: Manually record a completed move or port to a different upstream base. Initial imports/clones and same-base history repairs do not count.
policies.full_history_rewrites: Manually record a deliberate completed reconstruction of the whole fork stack, including local reconstructions not yet pushed. A single-commit amendment or a suffix-only rewrite does not count. Replaying descendants is not by itself evidence of another reconstruction.
policies.automatic_fields: Derive COMMITS from the current first-parent stack after FORK-BASE; reserve BUILD per full source commit, starting at zero, under a shared lock.
policies.automation: No rebase/push hooks or reflog heuristics increment either manual counter. Repeated pushes and failed pushes do not count as additional reconstructions.

seed_audit.limits: Expired logs, deleted repositories and unavailable past source cannot be recovered by this audit. Local reconstruction events and remote publication observations are not double counted.
